title: Rams HC Sean McVay says star WR Puka Nacua’s status for Sunday Night’s game vs. the Broncos is TBD

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams HC Sean McVay says star WR Puka Nacua’s status for Sunday Night’s game vs. the Broncos is TBD
sources.description: According to Nate Atkins, who covers the Rams for The Athletic, head coach Sean McVay told reporters that Nacua’s status for Sunday Night’s game vs. the Broncos is currently TBD.
